since.description: Return messages with seq greater than this. Defaults to the acknowledged seq.

wait.description: Long-poll: seconds (0-25) to wait for a new message when there is none yet. When one arrives, a few more seconds of a burst are collected into the same answer; on timeout the page is empty. Waiting tool reads are limited per agent (about 6 a minute); a 429 carries a retry-after and means stop polling (docs/WAKE.md).
